records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Good to see you've got a project set up in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work you're tracking is usually the fastest way to see where it fits.

Since you're on the Team plan, it tends to click once someone else is in there with you 
invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, or bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through whichever next step is most useful for your team.

Best,
Priya
